high_level_description: A single golden retriever dog running dynamically across a minimalist landscape with pale sky above and grass below, centered in a 1600x900 frame, rendered in warm golden tones.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale sky occupies top 75% (y=0 to y=675); light green grass occupies bottom 25% (y=675 to y=900).

elements.desc: Golden retriever body: horizontal rounded rectangle, golden yellow, centered, showing forward-leaning running posture
Dog head: large oval, golden yellow, positioned above front half of body
Left floppy ear: tall vertical ellipse, slightly darker gold, hanging from left side of head
Right floppy ear: tall vertical ellipse, slightly darker gold, hanging from right side of head
Front-left leg: vertical tapered rectangle, golden yellow, extended forward
Front-right leg: vertical tapered rectangle, golden yellow, extended forward
Rear-left leg: vertical tapered rectangle, golden yellow, extended backward
Rear-right leg: vertical tapered rectangle, golden yellow, extended backward
Tail: upward-curving thin rectangle, golden yellow, extending from rear of body
